subject: Urban Planning
title: The City of 2100: What Will It Look Like?
description: Learn The City of 2100: What Will It Look Like? in one minute.

hook.text: By 2100, 10 billion people will share the planet. 8 billion will live in cities. What will those cities look like?

buildup.text: Climate adaptation will reshape skylines. Buildings will generate energy, capture carbon, and grow food on their walls.

discovery.text: Autonomous vehicles will eliminate parking — freeing 30% of urban land for housing, parks, and public space.

twist.text: The biggest change won't be technology. It will be governance — who decides how cities grow, and for whom.

climax.text: The best cities of 2100 will be the ones that learned from every mistake described in this course. The worst will repeat them.

punchline.text: We know what works. Parks, transit, density, equity. The future city is a choice.

quiz.question: What will be the most important factor shaping cities by 2100?
options: Which technology becomes dominant for transportation and energy
Governance — who decides how cities grow and who they serve
How many people the planet can physically accommodate
